candidates.explanation: The domain-to-persistence mapper assigns persistenceEntity.lastName = domainEntity.firstName. Every create and update through the relational repository goes through this mapper, so the surname is always overwritten with the first name when saved. That causes both 'Jane Jane' at registration and the overwrite on profile edit.

fix.description: Map lastName from domainEntity.lastName instead of firstName.
